Notiz aus der Oberfläche von Proxmox anz: Show the note from the Proxmox web interface
Bei 1 ist der Container unprivilegiert:: 1 means the container is unprivileged: its IDs are shifted on the host (usually by 100000). Without this line it is privileged.
Eingehängter Ordner: zuerst die Quelle a: Mounted folder: first the source on the host (or a Proxmox storage), mp= is the target inside the container, ro=1 means read-only.
Eingehängter Ordner als LXC-Zeile, an de: Mounted folder as a raw LXC line, bypassing the Proxmox interface: source on the host, target inside the container (without a leading /), options.
Eigenes Mapping: u für Benutzer, g für G: Custom mapping: u for users, g for groups, then the ID inside the container, the ID on the host and the count. Anything not covered shows up as nobody inside the container.
Eigene LXC-Einstellung, an der Oberfläch: Raw LXC setting, bypassing the Proxmox interface.
Zusatzfunktionen: nesting=1 brauchen Doc: Extra features: nesting=1 is needed by Docker and newer systemd, keyctl=1 by Docker in an unprivileged container, mount=nfs;cifs allows the container to mount network shares itself.
Netzwerkkarte mit Adresse (ip=) und Brid: Network card with address (ip=) and bridge.
Bei 1 startet der Container mit dem Prox: 1 means the container starts together with Proxmox.
Schlagwörter aus der Oberfläche von Prox: Tags from the Proxmox web interface.
Durchgereichtes Gerät des Hosts (z. B. G: Device passed through from the host (e.g. a graphics card).
Bei 1 lässt sich der Container nicht lös: 1 means the container cannot be deleted.
The container is locked right now, e.g. during a backup.
PermLens kann alle sechs Stunden bei Git: PermLens can check GitHub every six hours for a new version. If there is one, a note appears at the bottom of every page. Only the public list of releases is read; PermLens sends no data from your Proxmox. You install the new version yourself (Dockhand: Pull and Redeploy).
